title: Theoretical and Observational Bounds on Dynamical Chern-Simons Gravity as an Effective Field Theory
summary: Gravitational effective theories are essential for characterizing the space of deviations from General Relativity (GR). Testing these theories against fundamental principles, such as causality and unitarity, can yield constraints on the corresponding parameters. In this paper, we perform such an analysis on the very interesting dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity. This is a parity violating correction to GR wherein a new scalar field couples to the Pontryagin density $^*R\,R$.
